3.title: Christopher

candidates.text: A Native American group picketing the local Columbus Day parade has Tony's crew taking the whole thing personally.

candidates.text: Silvio keeps grousing about disrespect toward Italians until Tony snaps at the whole idea of victimized groups.

candidates.text: Ralphie tries leaning on the man organizing the protest, hoping threats will get the demonstration called off.

candidates.text: Tony sits down with a supposed chief who turns out to be a white man with barely any Native blood.
